context: Ren reports a joint project's finances to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (財政/共同/運用/資本/向上) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 共同事業の財政が、改善しました。
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資本の運用が、効いたのかね?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、運用の効率が向上しました。
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同の相手も、満足かね?
lines.en: Is the joint partner satisfied too?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 共同の信頼も、向上しています。
lines.en: Trust in the partnership is rising too.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資本を、さらに活かせるかね?
lines.en: Can we leverage the capital further?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 運用を見直し、財政を強くします。
lines.en: We'll review management and strengthen finances.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 向上を続けてくれ。期待している。
lines.en: Keep improving. I'm counting on it.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
